repository.name: agid-postal-lb
repository.purpose: Lebanon postal-context contract seed for an independent country-data repository linked to AGID

postal_system.current_code_name: Lebanon four-digit or spaced eight-digit postal reference
postal_system.legal_rule: LibanPost exposes operational address, P.O. Box or ZIP code, map-pin and NAC fields. The UPU Lebanon addressing sheet documents building, unit, street or area, city or village and district structure, while the reviewed August 2026 Lebanon sections of the Universal POST*CODE reference list 9999 and 99 999 999 formats. These establish syntax and address context only, not a public current assignment table, canonical national postal polygons, reusable addresses, exact buildings or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.assignment_rule: Store official postal values as either four digits or canonical NN NNN NNN, preserving leading zeroes. Production assignment requires an exact current LibanPost or other legally authorised rights-cleared record with code, object type, authority, validity, retrieval timestamp, response schema and digest pinned. NAC, map pins, P.O. boxes, post offices, UPU examples, administrative P-codes, cadaster zones, parcels, title records, coordinates, proximity and models do not independently create a postal assignment.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No reviewed canonical national Lebanon postal-code polygon artifact is bundled. A postal-authority surface requires an exact geometry artifact and postal relation with authority, edition, coverage, rights, CRS, topology and digest pinned. Joining a proven assignment to separately permitted governorate, district or cadaster geometry remains a derived postal-administrative join surface with uncertainty. Administrative P-codes are not postcodes; NAC, post offices, P.O. boxes and address or delivery objects remain point or non-area unless postal authority proves an area. Voronoi, interpolation, OSM and models never become official postal polygons.
postal_system.address_rule: Recipient, organisation, building name or number, floor, apartment or block, street or area, city or village, district (kaza), P.O. Box, postcode, NAC and coordinates remain typed, sourced and validity-aware. A postcode, NAC, map pin, administrative P-code, cadaster, parcel, title lookup, coordinate or nearest feature alone does not identify a recipient, owner, occupant, entrance, unit, exact legal civic address or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.building_rule: Building display requires an explicit rights-cleared civic-address identifier, a stable reviewed relation to a building identifier, and separately permitted building geometry with purpose, validity, privacy, CRS and digests pinned. LibanPost form fields, NAC, MOPH boundaries, Lebanon Atlas, cadastral zones and DLRC parcel or title evidence are not public address-building datasets. Postal or administrative containment, parcel overlap, coordinate equality and nearest-building logic are candidates or validation evidence only.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. A postal object, NAC location or derived surface may link to AGID cells through an explicit versioned crosswalk without relabelling a postcode, NAC, administrative P-code, governorate, district, cadaster, parcel, address or building as an AGID cell, or claiming AGID geometry is postal-authority geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: Pin publisher, exact page, item, layer or service URL, publication and download dates, terms or licence version, attribution, fields, CRS, schema and digest for every production artifact. LibanPost pages, UPU sheets, ArcGIS access, public viewers, blank copyright text, atlas lineage, cadastral office descriptions or paid lookup access do not grant blanket row, layer, address, parcel, title or building redistribution rights.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Recipients, accounts, address and postcode queries, map pins, NAC tokens, coordinates, P.O. Box holders, phone or email, identities, residents, owners, occupants, tenants, parcels, units, title-register records, access credentials and private premises are excluded from public artifacts. Apply Lebanon Law 81/2018, Article 98 guidance and exact lawful approvals before access, linkage, transfer or publication; only explicitly public or licensed non-personal fields may enter a production pack.

stages.definition: Contracts and synthetic conformance fixtures only; no real data promotion.

Current rights-reviewed LibanPost or legally authorised typed assignments and independently licensed point, route or area geometry pass declared-scope coverage, assignment validity, CRS/topology, temporal coverage, privacy and provenance checks, with reproducible transformation, approved immutable publication and actual AGID loader/API verification. NAC, administrative P-codes and AGID remain distinct identifiers; exact civic/building display needs a separate explicit permitted relation.
